t2i_prompt: Case study page mockup as an engineering record: a warm cream document sheet with a thin double-rule frame, centred on a deep navy background under a navy nav bar with breadcrumb. Left-aligned monospaced header block, a small schematic line drawing with steel-blue fills inset top-right. Down the left, four oversized monospaced figures with units, each with a small uppercase mono caption: <CONTENT>. Across the bottom, a hairline horizontal milestone timeline with six steel-blue dots and short labels. Flat, sober, generous whitespace, data-led.
signature_idea: A case study reads like a signed engineering record, with outcomes as huge measured numbers and a dot timeline from order to water release.
strengths: strong match to 'name the number with its unit' voice
honest placeholder brackets fit the drafting stage
weaknesses: all-monospace text is heavy and typewriter-like
inset diagram too small to read
large empty right column under the diagram
brand_fit_why: Navy/limestone, steel-blue dots and big mono figures match Geist Mono figures; using mono for headlines and body instead of Geist light, plus rounded corners, misses.
